name: Takasaki Chidori
source:
An eccentric ballet celebrity. Thought of as unapproachable since her emotions don't show on her face, she often causes unnecessary drama because of her tendency to ask questions about things she shouldn't. She'll express herself honestly when it comes to things she's interested in. Other than that, she doesn't do anything unnecessary.

Before entering the academy, she was involved in the entertainment industry, predominantly theater, and so is one of the best in the school at ballet and singing

She is assigned as [url=/c16869]Erika's[/url] Amitié partner, but their mutual eccentricities lead to them often being at odds with one another.

Her hobbies are classical ballet and voice training.

[Benichidori (Rosaceae family)]
Language of Flowers:  [How Lovely] [Refinement] [Nobility] [Devotion]

[From [url=http://flowersgame.com/flowers---le-volume-sur-ete--.html]English official page[/url] and [url=http://www.gungnir.co.jp/lily/flowers2/flowers2_chidori.html]Japanese official page[/url]]
translation:
一位古怪的芭蕾舞明星。由于她不在脸上表露情绪，人们觉得她难以接近；她还总爱询问不该问的事情，经常引发不必要的骚动。遇到感兴趣的事，她会坦率表达自己的想法。除此之外，她不会做任何多余的事。

进入学园前，她曾涉足娱乐行业，主要从事舞台剧，因此在校内的芭蕾舞和歌唱水平数一数二。

她被安排成为[url=/c16869]艾丽卡[/url]的Amitié搭档，但两人同样古怪，经常互相不合。

她的爱好是古典芭蕾和声乐训练。

[红千鸟（蔷薇科）]
花语：[多么可爱][优雅][高贵][奉献]
